decisions.reason: As a core-adjacent formwork system that was still prominently marketed in 2019, it likely has strong strategic fit and low enough continuation cost to keep the option open.
This shuttering magnet block sits close to the established modular offer and, without a clear failure signal, is relatively inexpensive to retain as a complementary niche product.
Because it had its own product page and fits the firm's magnetic formwork portfolio, management would likely continue it unless later sales evidence became clearly unfavorable.
Although it was less prominently presented, it still complements the firm's tailored systems and is likely worth keeping while demand remains somewhat uncertain and carrying costs stay limited.
